_doc: Ranks earned by deeds (ranks.gd, docs/make_it_fun.md H). Routine XP (sim.gain_xp) raises a skill only up to routine_cap; past it each band of levels is a rank, in `bands` order: a rank holds the levels above the previous cap up to its own `cap_lv`, so the rank is read from the level (ranks.rank_of). When a skill's XP is full at the top of a band, its next rank's trial is open: the person needs the deeds in `trial` (any one of them, {deed: count}; counts come from the deed record u.deeds) to step into the next band, and the XP that was waiting carries them there. Deeds: slay_<beast kind> (wolf, tiger), slay_warrior, masterpiece, lead_build (led a frontier outpost to completion), invent (made a breakthrough), open_era (a breakthrough that opened a new age), repel_raid (in a defence that drove off a war band), win_war (led a war party home), seal_deal (sealed an agreement with a clan), seal_alliance (an alliance), taught_<skill> (someone who once worked under them earned their own first rank in that skill; who worked under whom is u.mentors, filled by contracts). Per skill and rank: title (what they are called), desc (the trial, as the sheet shows it). first_feat: the tribe's first of each rank is an achievement. log, popup, remember: texts of a rank-up (vars: who, title).

_gates_doc: What a rank lets people do (ranks.gd may/tribe_can/tribe_has). Each gate names the skill and rank it takes and its desc (shown on the sheet). A tribe gate holds while anyone living holds the rank; a person gate is about that person. tame: calves are tamed in the pens (sim._herd). big_pens: each pen holds `add` more oxen (sim.ox_cap). fine_craft: upgrades, renovations and bronze working (sim.upgrades_for, renovate_one, has_bronze). keeper: their knowledge keeps every known secret from dying out (evo.on_death). lead_war: may lead a war party (contracts). war_chief: may be appointed War Chief (sim.appoint_block). long_treaties: treaties they seal last `mult` times as long (rivals.seal). The Centurion Aura and the master trader's prices name their rank in rules.json (skills.aura.rank, folk.trade.master_rank). blocked: why a gate is shut (var: the rank's title).
